methodology.chronology: Actual entry sessions, then partial exits, final exits, costs and slippage; same-session entries are admitted before exits.
methodology.double_costs: Frozen strategy rerun with doubled transaction costs and adverse slippage before applying identical constraints.
methodology.material_drawdown_reduction_definition: At least 25% less severe than the unconstrained -33.4002R chronological drawdown.

ranking.best_risk_reward: Descending planned TP1 risk/reward; frozen plans are 2R, so deterministic ticker order resolves equal values.
ranking.lowest_risk_percentage: Ascending executable entry-to-stop distance as a percentage of entry.
ranking.one_highest_ranked_per_sector: Daily sector round-robin, highest confidence within each sector; it ranks rather than imposes a sector cap.

methodology.selection_tie_break: When point metrics are identical because constraints are redundant, prefer the lower configured position, open-risk, and daily-risk limits, then the first listed ranking method.
